description: This Java class 'JNDITransactionFactory' implements the 'TransactionFactory' interface, providing methods to retrieve transaction managers, user transactions, and database connections via JNDI lookups, with caching and support for XA data sources.

classes.name: JNDITransactionFactory
classes.description: Implements transaction management via JNDI lookups, providing methods to retrieve transaction managers, user transactions, and database connections, with caching and support for XA data sources.

methods.description: Retrieves the UserTransaction via JNDI lookup, with lazy initialization and synchronization.

methods.name: getTxMgrName
methods.description: Returns the name identifier for this transaction manager, 'jndi'.
